purpose: Supplemental, open-vocabulary semantic-scene examples explicitly supplied by the user after the original 50-case fixture; regression guidance, not a closed taxonomy.
scope: Every new or imported deck path must plan and place relevant scenes from source semantics; the same concrete scene appears at most once per deck, while distinct sub-scenes use distinct scene identities and assets.

behavioral_assertions: UE01, UE02 and UE03 share the broad consumer-spending topic but require three distinct scene identities and three different scene assets.
UE01 and UE36 describe the same concrete supermarket-shopping scene across Chinese and English; they must resolve to one canonical scene and at most one placement per deck.
UE17, UE18 and UE19 are distinct cup product/use scenes and must not collapse to one generic cup image.
UE22 through UE27 are distinct healthcare settings/actions; avoid patient identifiers, records or invented clinical claims.
UE28 through UE31 are distinct elder-care contexts and must be depicted respectfully, not as interchangeable stereotypes.
These examples are regression inputs only. New vocabulary and domains must continue to work without a fixed list or generic text-card fallback.
